_source: Hover cards for the action bar's close-quarters actions (Hud.action_help), like net_help.json for the NET panel. Short paraphrases of CPR core p.168-169, p.177, p.183-184 and p.180 (Put Out Fire) as distilled in docs/rules/combat.md sections 3, 5 and 7; hand-edited. Each entry: name, cost, text (what it does), key (its roll or numbers), page, book (default CPR core; SPM = Single Player Mode). Ids are Encounter.grapple_options(). An entry with no text gets no hover card (owner verdict 2026-11-10: release, escape and put_out need none); its name, cost and cite stay as the record.

grab.name: Grab
grab.text: Hold an adjacent enemy. You both take -2 while it lasts; they can't move.
grab.key: DEX + Brawling + 1d10 vs theirs, ties to them

choke.name: Choke
choke.text: Damage equal to your BODY to the person you hold, ignoring armor (nonlethal).

throw.name: Throw
throw.text: Throw the person you hold: damage equal to your BODY, ignoring armor. The grapple ends and they're Prone.

shield.name: Human Shield
shield.text: Your grappled enemy blocks ranged attacks that aren't aimed. If they die, their body is a shield with HP equal to their BODY.
shield.key: cover · no dodge for the shield

escape.name: Escape
escape.key: DEX + Brawling + 1d10 vs the holder's, ties to them

break.name: Break Hold
break.text: End the grapple on an ally.
break.key: DEX + Brawling + 1d10 vs the holder's, ties to them

get_up.name: Get Up
get_up.text: Stand up. While Prone you have no Move Action.

spoof.name: Spoof
spoof.text: Tamper with a camera or alarm panel within 3 squares. Success adds a die back to the detection clock and the camera stops reporting. Failure rolls the clock.
spoof.key: TECH + Electronics/Security Tech (+ Field Expertise) vs DV15
